versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this release.

- No file changes detected compared to the previous version.

- Initial release of elegant-one-pager-architect skill.
- Transforms disorganized notes or meeting records into a concise, visually modern HTML one-pager.
- Extracts factual information, cleans up language, and dynamically renders structured executive summaries with clear color-coded sections.
- Supports removal of empty data/progress modules for clean layout.
- Designed for generating executive summaries, report one-pagers, formatted cards, and export-friendly layouts on demand.
